individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample measurement (n=141); marginal histograms also show full distributions.
Scatter-type plot with error bars representing variability across replicates; classified as a scatter plot, which is exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Line/density plot showing distributions; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Boxplots have individual data points (circles) overlaid in addition to box/whisker summary.
Polar histograms display the full binned distribution of phase differences, not a single average needing underlying points.
Polar histogram showing distribution by subtype; histogram bars already represent the full binned data.
Line plot showing a single representative raw signal trace with fitted model; not an averaged summary requiring individual points.
Scatter plot with error bars (fit uncertainty) per sample; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional individual point overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot with marginal histograms; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean plus/minus s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]).
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and defined in the caption as mean +/- s.d.
Density/distribution curves with no error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Boxplot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Polar histogram with no error bars.
Polar histogram with no error bars.
Illustrative line plot of a single fitted signal trace; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and explicitly defined as standard deviation of fitted parameters.
